answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the pearl is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the nebula of a task receipt, and the zephyr is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
